Tentang pekerjaan ini

Role Overview

As a Senior AI/MLOps Engineer specializing in ML Pipeline & Platform Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in scaling Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison's AI and data intelligence capabilities across our digital ecosystem. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end design, automation, and operational management of high-throughput machine learning pipelines and cloud platform environments on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will empower data scientists and AI engineers by building robust CI/CD deployment automation, optimizing high-scale BigQuery workflows, enforcing zero-trust platform security guardrails, and supporting emerging Agentic AI platform integrations to accelerate Indonesia's digital transformation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and Operate ML Pipelines: Design, build, compile, and maintain enterprise-grade Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) and Vertex AI Pipelines for automated training, evaluation, continuous batch inference, and automated retraining.
  • Optimize High-Scale Data Workflows: Engineer and optimize large-scale BigQuery data extraction, partitioned and clustered dataset transformations, and automated data pipelines handling multi-million row operational datasets.
  • Drive Platform Provisioning & Governance: Review Architectural Requirement Specifications (ARS) and execute infrastructure provisioning across GCP services (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Spanner, Cloud Storage, and GKE).
  • Enforce Platform Security & Guardrails: Implement least-privileged Identity & Access Management (IAM), per-pipeline service account bindings, and VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) perimeters to prevent unauthorized data access and egress leaks.
  • Champion Blast Radius Governance: Conduct comprehensive pre-deployment verification checklists for IAM policies, dependencies, and external partner integrations to guarantee zero service disruption.
  • Standardize CI/CD Automation: Build and maintain reusable GitLab CI/CD runner pipelines for pipeline compilation, automated testing, container image packaging, and progressive environment promotion.
  • Secure AI Tooling & Developer Harnesses: Establish security guardrails and governance policies for internal AI tooling, CLI assistants, and IDE developer harnesses, ensuring secret isolation, token sanitization, and auditability.
  • Support Emerging Agentic AI Integrations: Enable operational runtime configurations and backend service connectivity for Agentic AI frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and conversational agent deployments.
  • Lead Technical Problem Resolution: Troubleshoot complex container dependency builds, private package repository configurations (Google Artifact Registry), and runtime environment discrepancies across Workbench and Cloud Build runners.
  • Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Governance, Cloud Operations, Enterprise Security, and external technology partners to ensure platform compliance, high availability, and rapid time-to-market.

Qualification

Professional Experience & Technical Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of total experience in software, data, or ML engineering, with at least 3+ years of dedicated hands-on experience in MLOps, DataOps, or DevOps within enterprise production environments.
  • Cloud & Big Data Mastery:
    • Deep operational expertise with Google Cloud Platform, specifically Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, IAM, and VPC Service Controls.
    • Strong experience in BigQuery performance tuning, partitioning, clustering, and stored procedures.
  • ML Pipeline & Orchestration:
    • Proven track record of designing, building, compiling, and monitoring production Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) or Vertex AI Pipelines.
    • Deep familiarity with model registry workflows, artifact versioning, and lifecycle management.
  • Programming & Automation:
    • Expert-level proficiency in Python, including object-oriented programming, packaging, data structures, and cloud SDK integrations.
    • Strong foundation in Linux environments and shell scripting.
  • DevOps & CI/CD Tooling:
    • Hands-on expertise building enterprise CI/CD workflows using GitLab CI/CD, Docker containerization, Helm, and GitOps methodologies.
    • Experience managing private package repositories using Google Artifact Registry.
  • Security & Governance Acumen:
    • Practical experience securing day-to-day engineering AI harnesses, managing service account tokens, and implementing Data Loss Prevention (DLP) best practices.
  • Certifications:
    • Google Cloud Certified Professional Machine Learning Engineer (Preferred / Nice to have).
    • Google Cloud Certified Professional Data Engineer (Preferred / Nice to have).
    • Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect (Preferred / Nice to have).
  • Value-Add / Bonus Qualifications:
    • Experience with Agentic AI engineering frameworks (Google ADK, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or MCP servers).
    • Familiarity with RAG evaluation frameworks (such as Ragas or DeepEval) and vector databases.
    • Exposure to Cloud Spanner, Redis/Memorystore, or GraphDB integrations.
Behavioral Competencies

  • Problem-Solving Agility: Exceptional analytical and diagnostic skills with the ability to resolve complex infrastructure, pipeline, and security challenges under fast-paced operational conditions.
  • Proactive Ownership Mindset: High sense of accountability, initiative, and drive to transform operational lessons into scalable, automated standards.
  • Collaborative Communication: Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary squads, data science teams, and vendor partners.
  • Continuous Learning & Adaptability: Eagerness to stay ahead of the curve in emerging MLOps practices, GenAI platform engineering, and modern cloud technologies.

Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (IDX: ISAT) ("IOH"), are here with our vision to become the most preferred digital telecommunications company of Indonesia. The IOH merger combines two highly complementary businesses between PT Indosat Tbk (“Indosat Ooredoo”) and PT Hutchison 3 Indonesia to create a new world-class digital telecoms and internet company for Indonesia that can better compete and create additional value for all stakeholders, including employees, customers, and shareholders. Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison is now the second-largest mobile telecoms business in Indonesia.

Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison will be guided by its corporate vision “To Become the Most Preferred Digital Telco of Indonesia” to capture the tremendous market opportunities presented by Indonesia’s digital and economic growth.

The Company’s enhanced scale, financial strength, and expertise, combined with its preeminent networks, talent, and strategic partnerships, will enable Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison to become a key telco player driving Indonesia’s digital transformation agenda. The Company will focus on its core mission of delivering world-class digital experiences while connecting and empowering every Indonesian.

  • Fighting Scams Requires More Than Technology. It Requires Collective Action.

    It was a pleasure to participate as a speaker at the 57th Annual Conference of the     International Institute of Communications (IIC) held on 14–15 October 2026 in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, as part of Communications Policy and Regulation Week 2026, hosted by Axiata.

    I had the opportunity to join fellow international regulatory and industry experts in the panel discussion “End-to-End Solutions for Scams and Fraud Prevention,”.

    As scams become increasingly sophisticated, particularly with the rapid advancement of AI, our response must evolve just as quickly. Technology is an essential part of the solution, but technology alone is not enough.

    At PT. Indosat Tbk , we believe that AI should not only drive innovation and digital transformation but also help create a safer and more trusted digital ecosystem.

    During the discussion, I emphasized three key priorities:

    🔹 Prevention over reaction — leveraging AI and network-level intelligence to identify and prevent scams before they reach consumers.

    🔹 Collaboration beyond boundaries — strengthening cooperation among telecommunications operators, regulators, financial institutions, and digital platforms, including across borders.

    🔹 Measuring meaningful impact — moving beyond the number of scams detected or blocked to understanding whether we are genuinely reducing harm and protecting consumers.

    One important reflection from the discussion: a decline in reported scams does not necessarily mean fewer victims. It may also mean fewer people believe reporting will make a difference.

    My thanks to International Institute of Communications (IIC) and fellow panellists for the engaging exchange of perspectives.

    As we accelerate our journey toward an AI-powered digital future, our collective responsibility is to ensure that technological progress goes hand in hand with consumer protection and public trust.

    The ultimate measure of success is not how many scams we detect, but how many people we prevent from becoming victims.

    #IIC2026 #Indosat #AI #ScamPrevention #DigitalTrust #ConsumerProtection #Telecommunications #DigitalTransformation

  • AI is now in almost every company. Keeping it under control is the hard part. Leaders keep running into the same three problems:
    → AI costs get harder to predict as usage grows
    → Your data is stored at home, but each AI request can still travel abroad
    → AI spreads across teams faster than anyone can track who is using what

    As per f5's CXO roundtables organized around the world, 73% of leaders say weak governance is the biggest thing stopping them from scaling AI. 50% still think “sovereignty” just means where their data is stored.

    Hence, On 9 October in Singapore, Indosat launched something we have been building in a stealth mode for some time - Indosat Intelligence Suite. Powered by F5.

    Indosat Intelligence Suite - One API. One secure connection. 300+ AI models, including global models hosted by Indosat, other global models and our own LLM - Sahabat AI. Your apps, teams and AI agents plug in once. We handle routing, caching, private retrieval (RAG), metering and isolation, you deliver your desired outcomes.

    Our Moat -
    1. Transparency. Live metering at the account level, so you always know who is using what and what it costs.
    2. Security. Technical, physical and logical isolation, governance and guardrails built in collaboration with expert partner f5
    3. Flexibility. Chose your own starting point. Pick any model, or let us recommend the best one for the job. No lock-in.

    Indosat was its own first customer. We used AI ourselves, proved the value, and now we’re opening it up to others. We’re not starting alone. HSBC, Kimi, Mercuria and INF are already building with us.

    Explore it:     https://lnkd.in/ghesWDNs
